title: add downgrade guard + schema migration safety for private-installer: version pinning, backup/restore, and rollback docs
author: Alicia Moreno
description: Motivation: Private deployments (VPC / on-prem) have a risk during upgrades where incompatible schema changes or missing backups can lead to failed downgrades. This PR adds a downgrade guard to the private-installer + accompanying Helm and Terraform checks, enforces version pinning for critical components during upgrade, and improves backup/restore and migration safety docs. Summary of changes: - Add a downgrade guard check that prevents applying migrations if a compatible backup snapshot is not present. - Enforce explicit version pinning for installer-managed components (postgres image tag, migration-tool, operator) during upgrade path. - Add pre-upgrade hooks that perform automated logical backups (pg_dump + WAL checkpoint) and verify checksum. - Add post-migration verification steps that run smoke tests (schema presence, essential indices, sample read/write). - Helm chart: new job template for preflight backups and an annotation to mark migration-safe releases. - Terraform: add validations for immutable resource names and a flag to opt into forced downgrade (requires manual approval). - Docs: extensive upgrade/rollback runbook for operators with explicit rollback steps and known failure modes. Checklist included in description below: - [x] Add downgrade guard implementation in private-installer controller - [x] Add pre-upgrade backup job template to Helm charts - [x] Add Terraform validation and opt-in flag for forced-downgrade - [x] Add migration verification job to Helm charts - [x] Add runbook and release notes content - [x] Unit tests for downgrade guard and backup validation - [x] Integration test added to perf-canary for upgrade path Testing performed: - Unit tests for downgrade guard logic and version pin detection (backend). - Integration test in perf-canary that runs an upgrade from v2025.10 -> v2025.11 with simulated failure and exercises rollback path. - Manual validation of backup/restore on an internal QA vpc cluster (restored data validated against checksum). - CI: lint, build, helm-template, terraform-validate, e2e (helm) all passed. Rollout plan: - Merge to main and cut release branch for Private. - Ship with a gradual rollout gated by telemetry; early adopters will have the guard enabled by default. - For customers requiring forced-downgrade, require a signed change request and a secondary approval in Linear. Rollback path: - If post-migration verification fails, the operator will automatically attempt to restore from the most recent validated backup and revert to pinned image tags. - If automatic restore fails, follow manual rollback runbook (steps included in docs). Related: ENG-7832 (upgrade safety), ENG-7901 (installer hardening), SUP-2123 (customer support case referencing failed downgrade).

release_notes: Added downgrade guard and safer upgrade/rollback tooling for Private installer. New pre-upgrade backup job and post-migration verification jobs. Version pinning enforced for installer-managed components. Operators: follow docs/private-installer/upgrade-rollback.md for upgrade and rollback procedures.
testing_notes: Integration tested in perf-canary (simulated failed migration + automatic restore). Manual backup/restore verified on QA vpc cluster. CI passed after one flaky e2e rerun.
upgrade_impact: This makes upgrades safer by preventing schema migrations unless a validated backup exists and verified. No automatic breaking change expected; operators must ensure backup hooks run before applying migrations.
rollback_instructions: If migration verification fails the operator will attempt automatic restore from the latest validated backup and revert pods to pinned images. If automatic restore fails, follow manual runbook: 1) disable traffic, 2) run terraform to point to previous release values, 3) restore DB from validated backup snapshot, 4) run smoke tests from docs/private-installer/upgrade-rollback.md.
notes_for_support: SUP-2123: Customers previously hit a failed downgrade due to missing backup; enable guard backport if necessary and run the included restore checklist. Contact platform-support for manual assistance.

additional_context: We deliberately keep force_downgrade gated and require Linear approval to avoid accidental data loss. The Terraform change will surface a plan-time validation failure if resource names would be mutated during a downgrade.
